dataset: Dated lake and tributary water-quality observations
required_fields: observation_id; observation_date_or_timestamp; station_id; station_name; latitude; longitude; waterbody; lake_zone; dissolved_oxygen_mg_l; water_temperature_c; ph; nitrate_mg_l; phosphate_mg_l; ammonia_mg_l_if_measured; bod_mg_l; chlorophyll_a_if_measured; unit; analytical_method; qa_flag; source_record_id
format: CSV or XLSX plus data dictionary
acceptance_criteria: Dated records with station identifiers; units, methods, and QA flags documented; missing values preserved as blanks or documented codes

required_fields: station_id; station_name; latitude; longitude; coordinate_precision; geodetic_datum; waterbody; lake_zone; station_type; active_from; active_to; analytical_method; notes
acceptance_criteria: Coordinates and zone field supplied; datum stated; no zones inferred from station names

required_fields: variable; aggregation_rule; inclusion_exclusion_rule; detection_limit; missing_code; qa_flag_definition; unit; method; period; notes
format: PDF or DOCX or data dictionary
acceptance_criteria: Rules sufficient to understand or reproduce the published annual summaries; missing codes defined

dataset: Fish-kill incident and associated water-quality records
period: 2016-2025; earlier digital records if readily available
required_fields: incident_id; start_date; start_time; end_date; end_time; date_precision; municipality; barangay; waterbody; lake_zone; latitude; longitude; species; estimated_mortality; mortality_unit; affected_area; cause_reported; investigation_status; report_source; report_date; notes; associated_do_mg_l; associated_water_temperature_c; associated_ph; associated_other_parameters; associated_water_quality_date; associated_water_quality_unit; associated_water_quality_method; associated_water_quality_qa_flag
format: CSV or XLSX plus document index
acceptance_criteria: Event-level records with dates and locations; associated water-quality values dated and linked to the incident; investigation status and source documented; aggregates not expanded

resolution: Daily or monthly depending on source
required_fields: period; area_or_station; reporting_expected; reports_received; zero_report_confirmation; source; custodian; notes
acceptance_criteria: Evidence that absence of a report means a credible negative for a defined period, not merely that no article was found

dataset: Authoritative lake-zone boundary and station crosswalk
required_fields: zone_id; zone_name; boundary_geometry; station_id; station_name; crosswalk_source; effective_date; notes
format: Shapefile or GeoJSON plus lookup table
acceptance_criteria: Authoritative boundary or source-approved crosswalk; no mapping guessed from station names

agency: Philippine Atmospheric Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA)
dataset: Daily rainfall air-temperature and wind observations
required_fields: date; station_id; station_name; latitude; longitude; rainfall_mm; air_temperature_c; wind_speed; wind_speed_unit; wind_direction; qa_flag; completeness_flag; source
acceptance_criteria: Daily values with station metadata; units and completeness flags documented; gaps preserved

agency: Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR)
dataset: Fish-kill reports investigations and response records
period: 2016-2025; earlier digital records if readily available
required_fields: incident_id; date; time; municipality; barangay; waterbody; lake_zone; latitude; longitude; species; mortality; mortality_unit; cause; response_action; laboratory_result; investigation_status; source; notes
format: CSV or XLSX plus document index
acceptance_criteria: Event-level records with source and investigation status; aggregate counts are not treated as individual events

agency: City Government of Biñan and Municipal Government of Pila
required_fields: incident_or_period; date; time; barangay; waterbody; species; mortality; mortality_unit; action_taken; damage_assessment; report_source; reporting_completeness; notes
format: CSV or XLSX or signed summary
acceptance_criteria: Official records or a written statement that no record exists for a defined period; estimates clearly labeled
